_what: Provider-price provenance for the media estimator. Values were read from the official OpenAI documentation.
_how_to_refresh: Re-read the OpenAI model and pricing pages, then run packages/cost/src/media.test.ts.

entries.unit: USD per output video-second, per resolution
entries.notes: OpenAI Videos API. The adapter pins model, prompt, 720x1280 portrait size and an officially supported duration.

vendor.pricingInfoOverride: tts-1 costs $15.00 per 1 million characters ($0.015 per 1000 characters).

entries.notes: The adapter pins WAV output, voice, and speed 1.
Verbose JSON with word timestamps is requested for caption timing.

vendor.pricingInfoOverride: GPT Image 2 low 1024x1536 output costs $0.005 plus prompt input tokens; reserve $0.01.

entries.notes: Conservative per-image reservation: low-quality 1024x1536 output plus a short prompt-input allowance.

sceneKinds._what: 20.2 §2.3 / ADR-019 — the per-scene-kind economics the scene contract is justified by.
sceneKinds._derived: DERIVED from the provider entries above, not separately sourced. media.test.ts recomputes every number here from the live tables, so the ADR's arithmetic cannot rot silently while a price row moves.

perScene.note: A free-library clip. It BUYS a line (a mediaJobs row and landed bytes) at a price of zero — unlike uploaded_video/text_card, whose `buys` is null because nothing is fetched at all.
A free-library photograph, panned like an animated_image but at zero.

reel30s._what: The §2.3 worked example, REPRICED against the shipped tables. The plan's $1.36-vs-$3.00 predated the gpt-image-2 cutover, and the all-generated column turned out not to exist at all.

mixed.scenes: 3 generated x 4s + 4 stills x 4s + 1 card x 2s

generatedOnly.why: every clip length sora-2 supports is a multiple of 4 s, so no sum of them is 30

stockLeaning.scenes: 1 generated x 4s + 3 stock_video x 6s + 1 stock_image x 8s
stockLeaning._what: The lever the skill body teaches, priced: the same 30 seconds as `mixed` at a third of its picture cost, because four of its five scenes come from a free library instead of a generator.
